sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
The Finance module is the hotel's double-entry accounting system — all revenue (FO, POS, Banquet, Laundry) and expenses are consolidated here.

In Analysis HMS the finance flow: create accounts in Masters (Group → Ledger) → Transactions (Voucher Entry) → Verification → Reports (Trial Balance, P&L, Balance Sheet). POS/Front Office settlement heads (Cash/UPI/Card/City Ledger) post to finance automatically — the accountant's manual entry remains only for adjustments/journals.

subsections.title: 2.1 Group Accounts
subsections.paragraph: Chart of groups of accounts — sub-groups of Assets, Liabilities, Income, Expenses. Ledger accounts are divided into these groups, so first make the group structure correct.

subsections.title: 2.2 Ledger Accounts
subsections.paragraph: Actual accounts where transactions are posted — Cash, Bank, MakeMyTrip, GST Payable, Salary, Rent etc. Every ledger is divided under some group.

subsections.title: 2.3 FA Parameter & TDS Category
subsections.navPath: Finance ▶ Master ▶ FA Parameter / T.D.S. Category
subsections.paragraph: FA Parameter: global settings of the finance module (financial year start, voucher numbering, posting rules). TDS Category: TDS types (194C contractor 1%/2%, 194J professional 10%) — for auto-TDS calculation on vendor payments.

subsections.title: 3.1 Voucher Entry
subsections.paragraph: Manual accounting entries — Payment, Receipt, Journal, Contra, Sales/Purchase (non-HMS). It is necessary to have Debit-Credit balance and the color is not saved.

subsections.title: 3.2 Bank Reconciliation
subsections.paragraph: Match bank statement transactions with system entries — tick the cleared entries. Difference = uncleared cheques/charges. Monthly reconciliation is a best practice.

subsections.title: 3.3 Verification Dashboard
subsections.paragraph: Internal control — a dashboard to verify/approve entered vouchers. Only verified vouchers effectively reach a 'trusted' state in final reports (as per the parameter).
